name: ansight-replay
description: Inspect Ansight captures in chat with recorded touches, screenshot annotations, and the full replay.

interface.shortDescription: Scrub, annotate, and inspect Ansight recordings.
interface.longDescription: Inspect screenshots and recorded touch overlays, save native Ansight point or rectangle annotations, ask ChatGPT to act on them, and open the full replay. Requires the Ansight CLI and a running local host.
defaultPrompt: Show my latest Ansight replay inside the chat, including recorded touches.
